visualCharacteristics.purpose: Promotional card pairing copy with a lifestyle photo
visualCharacteristics.layout: Rounded, shadowed card; text column (logo image, heading, copy, link) beside a photo that fills the card height and bleeds to its edge. Photo stacks on top below 900px
visualCharacteristics.notes: Card fill comes from the section style (e.g. light-blue) or the design pass; the photo column is detected as a picture-only cell, so it may sit on either side.

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: text cell (optional logo image, H2, paragraphs, link) and a picture-only cell
rows: logo image, H2, paragraphs, Learn more link

usage.description: Cross-sell or membership promo cards within an offer page.

reuseGuidance: Use for a single text-plus-photo promo card. For plain side-by-side columns without card chrome use the base columns block.
